source: Official DFL Bundesliga 2026/27 fixture data via openLigaDB (the DFL's public data service) — all 306 matches with kick-off times as published in the DFL fixture release
kickoffNote: Kick-off times are CET/CEST (Germany) as published by the DFL in the official fixture release. Typical slots: Friday 20:30, Saturday 15:30/18:30, Sunday 15:30/17:30/19:30.
subjectToChange: Fixtures and kick-off times are subject to change (TV selections, European competitions, DFB-Pokal). BRYME updates the list as official changes are announced.
